title: Citation-required research answer generation and grounding governor v0
problem: Blocked by ticket-424. The repo has synthesis packet machinery but no question-to-retrieval-to-cited-answer path. Answer generation must be downstream of the accepted evidence packet and fail closed when sentences cannot be resolved to packet evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A private command executes question to hybrid retrieval to bounded evidence packet to candidate answer without changing accepted graph data.
Every factual answer sentence cites resolvable packet claim IDs and source IDs; citations outside the packet or to ineligible claims are rejected.
The grounding governor validates claim/quote overlap, section and scope compatibility, citation coverage, and answer-level evidence diversity before GO.
Unsupported factual sentences, fabricated citations, missing citations, or packet-empty questions produce NO-GO or an explicit abstention, never an uncited answer.
Default behavior uses deterministic mock synthesis; live local or cloud synthesis remains behind existing explicit gates, provider allowlists, and budgets.
Answer artifacts are private candidates, disclose runtime and grounding verdict, and contain no raw prompts, secrets, local paths, or unbounded source text.
On completion, ticket-426 changes from blocked to ready; no later Phase 4 ticket is activated.
test_plan: With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_research_answer_runner.py tests/unit/test_research_answer_grounding.py tests/unit/test_synthesis_packet_runner.py -q
With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
non_goals: Do not add a public chat endpoint or public write route.
Do not let answer generation modify accepted claims, relationships, scores, or tickets.
Do not bypass abstention when evidence is insufficient.
Do not make live OpenAI or Ollama part of default verification.
rollback_plan: Remove the private answer command and contract while retaining ticket-423/424 evidence retrieval. Disable live synthesis providers; accepted graph data is unaffected.
